title: American Greed
description:
S12 E9 — Billion Dollar Fraud Goes Viral
By promising enormous returns on a work-from-home scheme selling TelexFree phone service, Carlos Wanzeler and James Merrill entice nearly one million people in an extraordinary $1.7 billion internet scam.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E11 — The Art of the Steal; Folsom Felon
A famous art dealer cons New York high society out of millions.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E12 — Hedge Fund Imposter
A superstar attorney impersonates an executive to bilk hedge funds out of millions.

title: American Greed
description:
S15 E5 — The Biggest Theft of All Time?
Jho Low is accused of being one of the biggest thieves the world has ever seen; authorities say he's the mastermind of an international scheme to steal over $4 billion from the government of Malaysia.

title: American Greed
description:
S11 E1 — Deadly Gold Digger
A femme fatale, with a way of getting men to do what she wants, sets a trap for a multi-millionaire divorcee.

title: American Greed
description:
S6 E3 — Nevin Shapiro: Major League Fraud
Nevin Shapiro, a football booster and a fixture on the Miami social scene, orchestrates a Ponzi scheme.

title: American Greed
description:
S7 E2 — The Wealth Builder Club
The son of a preacher bilks believers out of nearly $65 million promising huge returns for short-term investments.

title: Lockup: Savannah: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Hard on the Yard
One man prepares for life behind bars after running someone down with his car; another man must be placed in isolation for his own protection, after being accused of knowingly giving women HIV.

title: Lockup: Corcoran: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Everyone Gets Got
California State Prison, Corcoran is a turbulent sea of politics: from old school prison gangs to disruptive street gangs, it's a dangerous mix for staff and inmates; known gang members are sent to security housing units to control their activity.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — No Remorse
A threat against an officer leads to a major shakedown; an alleged gang leader becomes a magnet for trouble; a high-speed chase ends with the discovery of a 21-year-old murder victim and now the jail must deal with her cold-blooded killer.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Smoking Gun
A police shootout leaves a paroled inmate in the hospital with 14 bullet wounds and two other men are arrested for their connection to him; a female inmate arrives with what she says is a hair salon mishap, but officers suspect something else.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Going Postal
A new inmate tries to adjust to life in jail, but finds himself with a target on his back and the victim of violence; a drug smuggling scheme is uncovered in the jail's mailroom and a suspect is identified.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Mama's Boy Drug
A dangerous drug makes a comeback in the city of Hackensack, but this time with an "all in the family" twist; inmates are provided with cameras to record their intimate thoughts.

title: Lockup: New Jersey: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — God Is Not Here
A familiar face struggles to escape the jail's revolving door, but there's a catch; another inmate has pled guilty to manslaughter, but now in an unusual legal twist, he may have to stand trial for murder.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
S2 E2 — Never a Dull Moment
Our Lockup crews have found out many times that you never know when things will detonate.

title: Lockup: Raw
description:
